Haddock Lobo, 1571, Cerqueira César. Cocktails from 7 pm. Reservations advised. The civilised Wed close. › MASP — Av. Paulista, 1578. Open Wed until 18h. The pre-Blue Note culture stop, two minutes’ walk. › In Rio tonight: Cine Jazz #4 final at Blue Note Rio — Coltrane Jazz Casual 1963 with Fernando Trocado at 8 pm. Robertinho Silva at 10:30 pm. › This week: Apr 30 + May 1: The Weeknd at MorumBIS (After Hours Til Dawn). Apr 30: International Jazz Day at Blue Note SP. May 1: Chiara Civello at Blue Note SP. World.title: Rio de Janeiro Nightlife Guide for Wednesday, April 29, 2026
World.content:
The Rio Times · RT Nightlife Desk Cine Jazz #4 final April session — Coltrane / Jazz Casual / 1963 + Fernando Trocado at Blue Note Rio 8 pm · Seiferts convida Robertinho Silva 10:30 pm · Rio Scenarium reopens · Bip Bip bossa nova · Copom Day 2 · Selic decision ~18h30 · International Jazz Day in 1 day

01

Tonight’s Vibe Menu

Wednesday is when the Rio de Janeiro nightlife week comes back to full power — and tonight has both a marquee jazz event and the most important economic moment of the week. The Copom closes its 278th meeting tonight at around 18h30 with the Selic rate decision — currently 14.75 % and in a cutting cycle. Then at 8 pm, Blue Note Rio closes its Coltrane-Davis centenary series with the final April Cine Jazz: “Cine Jazz John Coltrane / Jazz Casual / 1963”, with guest Fernando Trocado for the lecture and 30-minute pocket show after. At 10:30 pm the second show is Seiferts convida Robertinho Silva: Tocando e Contando Histórias — Robertinho Silva, the legendary Brazilian percussionist, in conversation and performance. Across town, the full Lapa triangle is operational: Rio Scenarium reopens for its Wed–Sat run from 7 pm, three floors of samba and gafieira through 1 am. Carioca da Gema doors 7:30 pm, show 8:30 pm. Beco do Rato runs 6 pm–midnight with the Roda de Samba Aos Novos Compositores. Bip Bip in Copacabana hosts its weekly bossa nova roda from 8 pm — five minutes from Blue Note. Pedra do Sal not running tonight (Fri–Mon only). Warm Wednesday — 29 °C, 10 % rain, the autumn front clearing. Tomorrow: International Jazz Day at Blue Note Rio.

02

Top Picks Tonight

Fast scan

Cine Jazz #4 — Coltrane Jazz Casual 1963 + Fernando Trocado

8 pm · Eventim The final April Cine Jazz, closing the Miles Davis–Coltrane centenary series. 1963 Jazz Casual film + lecture + 30-min pocket show with Fernando Trocado. From May, the series moves to last Wednesday of each month. Av. Atlântica, 1910 — Copacabana.

Seiferts convida Robertinho Silva at Blue Note Rio

10:30 pm · Eventim Tocando e Contando Histórias — the legendary percussionist in conversation and performance with Marcos Seiferts. The natural late-session pairing with Cine Jazz. Av. Atlântica, 1910 — Copacabana.

Rio Scenarium — Wednesday Reopens

7 pm–1 am · ~R$30–40 The first Wednesday of the casarão’s Wed–Sat operating week. Three floors, samba and gafieira on the main stage, balcony rail seats, smaller crowd than the weekend. R. do Lavradio, 20 — Lapa. Sympla.

Bip Bip — Wednesday Bossa Nova

From 8 pm · Free The genre that grew from the same Copacabana where Cine Jazz screens the Coltrane recorded simultaneously across the Atlantic. Self-service from the fridge, finger-snap applause, silence during music. R. Almirante Gonçalves, 50 — Copacabana.

03

Full Rundown

Blue Note Rio — Cine Jazz #4 + Robertinho Silva double bill Copacabana · Jazz · Cinema · Eventim The full Wednesday programme on Av. Atlântica. The 8 pm Cine Jazz session is the fourth and final of April — closing the centenary series dedicated to Miles Davis (born 26 May 1926) and John Coltrane (born 23 September 1926). Tonight’s screening: “John Coltrane / Jazz Casual / 1963” — the legendary half-hour TV programme produced by Ralph J. Gleason for KQED, capturing Coltrane’s classic quartet (with McCoy Tyner, Jimmy Garrison, Elvin Jones) at the height of their powers, just before the 1964 recordings of Crescent and A Love Supreme. After the screening: lecture and conversation, then a 30-minute pocket show from Fernando Trocado. From May, the Cine Jazz series moves to the last Wednesday of each month. Rio Scenarium — Casarão Reopens Lapa · Samba · Gafieira · Three Floors First night of the casarão’s Wednesday-to-Saturday week. Closes at 1 am tonight. Wed 7 pm–1 am · ~R$30–40 · R. do Lavradio, 20 — Lapa · Sympla

Carioca da Gema — Wednesday Samba Lapa · Samba · Casarão · 25 Years The Lapa purist room running its midweek programme. Joaquim Silva, 11 — Lapa · Sympla · @becodorato
